say:2:1410321001:0.text: So, Zanie does know the dwarves from Brimstone Village. We decided to trust her, but who would've thought...
say:2:1410321001:0.source_cn: 祖娅与深岩村的那些矮人果然认识。我们才决定相信她，没想到……

say:3:1410321002:1.text: Even if she knows them, it sounds like she left ages ago.
say:3:1410321002:1.source_cn: 虽然认识，但祖娅似乎已经离开那里很久了。

say:4:1410321003:1.text: If the village's whole plan is to build the temple and resurrect Helthor, then maybe Zanie was so against the temple plan that she even left the village in protest against it.
say:4:1410321003:1.source_cn: 如果深岩村的真正目的是建造神殿复活赫托，听起来，祖娅似...

say:5:1410321004:1.text: Every time the temple or reviving their god comes up, she always reacts with disdain.
say:5:1410321004:1.source_cn: 不管是提到建神殿，还是提到复活神明，祖娅都表现出了嗤之...

say:6:1410321005:1.text: Are you saying we should still trust her?
say:6:1410321005:1.source_cn: 你的意思是，我们还是应该相信祖娅？

say:7:1410321006:1.text: Well, she's had plenty of chances to ditch us, but she didn't. And back in front of the High Priestess, she actually tried to cover for us.
say:7:1410321006:1.source_cn: 这一路上，祖娅有好几次甩下我们的机会，可她没有。在那位...

say:8:1410321007:1.text: I don't think she's a bad person. At least until we get back to the surface, we need her help.
say:8:1410321007:1.source_cn: 我认为，她不是坏人。至少在回到地面以前，我们仍然少不了...

say:9:1410321008:0.text: Chippy also thinks Zanie isn't bad... Magister, what do you think?
say:9:1410321008:0.source_cn: 满满也觉得祖娅不坏……主人，你说呢？
say:9:1410321008:0.male: Chippy also thinks Zanie isn't bad... Magister, what do you think?
say:9:1410321008:0.female: Chippy also thinks Zanie isn't bad... Magister, what do you think?

choice_prompt:10:1410321008.text: Chippy also thinks Zanie isn't bad... Magister, what do you think?
choice_prompt:10:1410321008.source_cn: 满满也觉得祖娅不坏……主人，您说呢？
choice_prompt:10:1410321008.male: Chippy also thinks Zanie isn't bad... Magister, what do you think?
choice_prompt:10:1410321008.female: Chippy also thinks Zanie isn't bad... Magister, what do you think?

say:11:1410321009:1.text: Besides, even if Zanie's keeping secrets from us, we're keeping secrets from her too.
say:11:1410321009:1.source_cn: 我在想，就算祖娅对我们有所隐瞒，其实，我们也有事瞒着她。

say:12:1410321010:1.text: She has no idea we're actually here to investigate the dwarves' rebellion. So, in a way, we're even.
say:12:1410321010:1.source_cn: 因为，祖娅并不知道我们实际上是来调查矮人叛变的，这么一...

say:13:1410321011:1.text: For now, the real priority is getting back to Brimstone Village and reporting everything to General Hogan. Until then, we should stay neutral toward Zanie.
say:13:1410321011:1.source_cn: 当务之急还是回到深岩村，把地下的发现告诉霍根将军。在那...

say:14:1410321012:1.text: Wow... Hammie, you've really thought a lot about this!

say:15:1410321013:1.text: Why, thank you! I do my best.
say:15:1410321013:1.source_cn: 你的夸奖我可要大大方方收下了。

say:16:1410321014:1.text: Don't get a big head over it.

say:17:1410321015:0.text: Stupid Chippy! What do you mean by that?!
say:17:1410321015:0.source_cn: 笨蛋满满！你这是什么意思！

say:19:1410321016:1.text: There you are! I leave you alone for two minutes, and you're already squabbling like a pair of miscalibrated cogwheels!
say:19:1410321016:1.source_cn: ——嘿！我到处找你们，原来是跑到这里吵架来了。

say:20:1410321017:1.text: Right, listen up! Yes, I lived in Brimstone Village, but that was a whole century ago.
say:20:1410321017:1.source_cn: 那个……我想解释两句，我以前确实生活在深岩村，但那已经...

say:21:1410321018:1.text: Eldric and I didn't see eye to eye on a lot of things, so I made the decision to pack up my research and go underground.
say:21:1410321018:1.source_cn: 我跟弗林那帮人合不来，于是借口出去游历，来到地下搞研究。

say:22:1410321019:1.text: And when you first mentioned him, I pretended not to know him because I didn't want to be associated with him.
say:22:1410321019:1.source_cn: 你们第一次提到弗林的名字时，我装作不认识，也是不想与他...

say:23:1410321020:1.text: That's fair. Everyone's got things they'd rather not talk about. The Magister and I understand.
say:23:1410321020:1.source_cn: 没事的祖娅，每个人都有些不想说的秘密，我们和主人能理解。
say:23:1410321020:1.male: That's fair. Everyone's got things they'd rather not talk about. The Magister and I understand.
say:23:1410321020:1.female: That's fair. Everyone's got things they'd rather not talk about. The Magister and I understand.

say:24:1410321021:1.source_cn: ……挺通情达理嘛，毛绒绒的小家伙！

say:25:1410321022:1.text: But when that dwarf called you Aunt, Chippy almost fell over! You don't look nearly old enough for that!
say:25:1410321022:1.source_cn: 不过，那位矮人叫你姑姑的时候把我吓了一跳，你怎么看也不...

say:26:1410321023:1.text: Well... I can't help it if I look young.
say:26:1410321023:1.source_cn: 这个……长、长得年轻，也不能怪我啊。

say:27:1410321024:1.text: Enough about that. The lift's waiting, so let's get a move on!
say:27:1410321024:1.source_cn: 不说这些，被小插曲耽误了一段时间，咱们去坐升降机吧。

choice:10:0:1.text: She doesn't seem like a threat.
choice:10:0:1.male: She doesn't seem like a threat.
choice:10:0:1.female: She doesn't seem like a threat.
